label: sec:categorical-action-intro
html:
The Lagrangian \mathcal{L}_q acts as an endomorphism of A. Its trace is a morphism \mathbf{1} o \mathbf{1}, in which the gravity, gauge, and matter terms forced by the QOU axioms can be read off. The rigid duality supplies the trace; no spacetime measure is invoked.

The categorical action defines \mathfrak{S} = \mathrm{tr}(\Phi) for a Lagrangian endomorphism \Phi \in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A). Choosing \Phi_q = \mathcal{L}_q delivers \mathfrak{S}_q = \mathrm{tr}(\mathcal{L}_q), which expands via the Frobenius--Hopf decomposition of \mathcal{D}_ abla^2 into three terms: gravity \mathrm{tr}(q R_{\int}), gauge \int_A \mathrm{tr}_A(F_ abla \wedge_q \star_q F_ abla), and matter \int_A(\psi^* \cdot \mathcal{D}_ abla \psi). This holds uniquely up to a single scalar \lambda \in R^ imes tracking the normalisation of \int_A.
